description: Maya holds up three fingers close to lens, sharp focus on hand, face soft behind
Maya shoves a coffee mug across the desk; it slides through frame
Maya holds up a hand-written card reading “your back isn’t tight. it’s this.”
Maya snaps from neutral waiting-face to animated mid-sentence expression to show the difference
Maya leans back, taps the on-screen space beside her as if pinning the checklist there
